strongestFinding: No public evidence establishes the untreated, suitable, uncommitted tank cohort. The case remains a source-envelope sensitivity, with zero additional benefit possible. Monitoring coverage and Pathway recognition must not be described as complete measured emissions verification.

suggestedAppUpdates: Headline: Additional feasible tank abatement not yet established.
Show 6.8 kt CH4/year reported tank-source proxy, not untreated emissions.
Move 25/50/100% cases into explicitly hypothetical sensitivity; display 0% and unknown eligibility prominently.
Use 90 MtCO2e/year operated Scope 1 for direct baseline; show 97 Mt Scope 1+2 separately. Net combustion-adjusted scenario is lifecycle-oriented and not a same-boundary inventory subtraction.
Add existing company programs and prevent double counting with LDAR, pneumatic replacement, and scheduled VRU work.
Show historical EPA economics separately from unknown current company investment/payback.
Use GWP as a climate metric; monetized damage requires an explicit damage model, preferably gas-specific rather than treating GWP equivalence as damage equivalence.
